snippet.title: Last Flag - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer and hero reveal for Last Flag, a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

The trailer reveals a free demo will be playable during Steam's Third Person Fest starting August 25th.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #lastflag

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
